observations.information_root: Bahrain Interior Ministry November 15 2026 threat alerts
observations.summary: Bahrain's Interior Ministry issued two separate potential-threat alerts urging residents to seek nearest safe location. The ministry did not identify the threat or report impacts. Reuters describes these as Bahrain's first such alerts since September; they follow an Iranian radar-strike claim denied by the U.S. military. No causal link or new successful attack is established.
observations.title: Bahrain issues first public threat shelter alerts since September
